llms: the first satellites of 1957–58 — Kepler orbits of Sputnik 1/2 and Explorer 1, the Doppler curve that let APL fit Sputnik's orbit and became Transit navigation (with an audible pass), Laika, the Geiger-counter dead-time paradox that revealed the Van Allen belts, Explorer 1's major-axis tumble, and Vanguard 1's pear-shaped Earth.
